summary.text: Chris Tipton is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 33, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physician assistant and first responder, he defeated incumbent Jordan Bridges in the May 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Chris Tipton earned a high school diploma from Man High School, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as physician assistant.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a healthcare provider, first responder and lifelong resident of Southern West Virginia who has worked in emergency medicine, critical care, family medicine, EMS, hospitals and clinics.
He said his father was a school teacher, his mother a nurse and his grandfather a coal miner.
Tipton defeated incumbent Republican Jordan Bridges in the May 12, 2026 primary for District 33, 610 votes (52.1%) to 560 (47.9%).
He faces Democrat Michael Browning and independent Leroy DeHart in the general election.
In the survey, Tipton named rural health care, including rural hospitals and EMS services, jobs and workforce training, and public safety and support for first responders as his main policy areas.
